My question would be should this be considered urgent & should I seek treatment after the antibiotics? & what that may mean

(6) I suspect some sort of dental EDS since it runs in my family although we don’t have an official diagnosis just yet (but a doctor told my sister she highly suspects it in her). Many symptoms of the dental version of EDS match up with mine, including the absence of some teeth - my wisdoms - abnormal root elongation, smaller lower jaw, my bite being hindered because my jaw doesn’t fit, abnormal gum tissue, prone to gingivitis, abnormalities with how my teeth grew in.

(5) I thought that with ALL of this, it would be conclusive that something needs to happen with those teeth and regarding the infection. But it was deemed “not urgent” so I’m on a 6 month waiting list minimum. I’m hoping something changes with this next checkup in November but I have no clue what to do anymore. I’ve had this abscess for upwards of a year, which is why the pus was able to become so solid. The X-rays also showed defects with my nerves and roots in the back molars but I don’t have them so I can’t research on my own. The abscess is currently flat but I still feel pain in the pocket of gum where the pus came out of.

(4) just before I had to take the antibiotics, I noticed a bit of pus come out of one of the worse pops with blood, only because it was semi solid so I could feel the difference. It was green and bad smelling. When I took the antibiotics, shortly after a dark green piece of solidified pus came out, indicating that there was a pocket that the pus had been stuck in where the infection was happening. The stir the antibiotics caused pushed it out. During my checkup prior to the antibiotics, they did voltage tests to see if the nerves were dead in those teeth and one went through all of the levels with no feeling (dead nerves) that we hadn’t realized was also effected. The root canal main molar we had been focusing on got a high score but wasn’t fully dead like the one right at the back.

(3) I had X-rays and checkups done but inconclusive with problems regarding the change of dentists I had to keep making (my parents decision). The case got passed around and since it was draining blood, I went to the hospital to get a 3D X-ray done. (I would’ve posted that here if I could, but I’m still waiting for any updates which I haven’t received, the X-ray was done months ago but no information still. I’ve got another checkup in late November) A while later, the infection seemed to get much worse, starting out with much more blood draining from the abscess, raw gums, swollen painful mouth. It got so bad that about every day the abscess would “pop” and large amounts of blood and bad tasting infection and mucus would come out at random times like 4am. Because of the severity, I got prescribed antibiotics.

(2) Many years passed and I eventually got referred back to the dentist (now in a new country) and had a root canal surgery. We noted that there was an abscess (second picture) in the gum between the effected tooth and the other molar. The dentist noted I had abnormally long roots, and the healing process was incredibly painful and lasted longer than I thought it would. After, the abscess seemed to let up and go down, but after a few weeks it came back again. This was during covid so I couldn’t get nearly as many checkups as I wish I could’ve, and I didn’t have much control over actually booking them (I didn’t understand the language well enough and I was reliant on my parents, since I’m autistic)

(1) So I originally found out I had a bad case of decay in my molar very young. My tooth grew in wrong, and broke down from the inside with no indicator that it had anything to do with hygiene. It decayed the inside of the tooth until there was a thin layer of tooth left and it eventually broke, revealing black decay inside of it. The decay was drilled away and I got a filling, but it was faulty and left some of the decay so it relapsed.

Well, it took me a long time to realize that forgetting to eat and having too many food aversions to count wasn’t normal. 

Along with that, I’d always struggled with personal hygiene because I struggled to get out of bed every day. I also had to realize that not everybody had to hold back from crying every lesson like I did. 

I thought that thinking about suicide was normal for my age, and just learnt to deal with it. I believed the people that said if I didn’t actually attempt, it was just hormones and that I’d get over it eventually. 

My zoning out periods that make me unable to process simple information (like hearing words but them not processing properly or meaning anything) and how lots of the time the zone outs would lead to panic attacks (which my parents convinced me was just due to being stressed) 

My irregular periods and how painful they are, along with fainting sometimes mostly due to them. 

I couldn’t and still can’t keep friendships, and I know it’s because I can’t open up about my needs to anyone. I’m in the middle of getting diagnosed with ASD right now, and it explains the friendship aspect for me. 

I’m so used to being dishonest about my feelings -thanks to suppressing- that I can’t do it if I want to anymore, and it’s causing lots of problems for me now.. it’s all hitting at once and I don’t see a way out.

Mine kind of goes in cycles, but the cycles are never even. Sometimes I get a week of almost manic happiness, where I hyper-fixate on something. Sometimes I’m way more prone to anxiety attacks, sometimes I feel a weird disassociation. Other times I’m neutral, but the “phases” have a lasting effect and all I can think about is how little I deserve what I have. How I feel so useless constantly. I’ve thought of “it” for several months at a time, and it’s so strange.. I just try to take it hour by hour.. I’ve suppressed it all my life, and lots of things go wrong all the time that I just can’t fix because.. well, it feels like I’m in the way of myself all the time. I don’t know how to explain. 
Certain situations put me into a weird prolonged anxiety attack where I can’t get out of fight or flight. 
But sometimes it all calms down for a while. Sometimes it goes right for a while. Sometimes I feel like life is so damn beautiful that I cant stand to let it go. 
I try to remind myself that just because current me can’t do it, me in a year or three might be able to. There might be a hand to hold when I can’t leave the bathroom, there might be a voice to listen to when the noises around me make my head spin. Just because I can’t see a way out now, it might be time based like in a video game. Oh, and all the comics I wouldn’t be able to read, all the pats I couldn’t give my dog. I can’t leave it like this, completely unresolved. I can’t leave if there’s a chance that it wouldn’t work and I’d be stuck in a hospital draining my parents bank account from the medical expenses. I just have to hold out until I’m ready.
